title: Where ZCHF is used today
intro: Services that take, hold or pay out Frankencoin, grouped by what you want to do. Each card says the concrete route.

cases.title: Pay at the till
cases.description: Pay at the checkout of over 100 Spar stores in Switzerland: the cashier shows a QR code, you confirm from a wallet that holds ZCHF.

cases.title: Online checkout
cases.description: Merchants add a crypto checkout to Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce or a custom shop. Customers pay in ZCHF; the merchant withdraws to a wallet they control.

cases.title: Buy with a bank transfer, pay bills
cases.description: Buy ZCHF by bank transfer to your own wallet, or link the wallet to a personal IBAN to receive transfers and pay Swiss QR bills in ZCHF.

cases.title: Visa card
cases.description: Zeal is the wallet app, Gnosis Pay issues the Visa debit card. Hold ZCHF in Zeal and spend it anywhere Visa is accepted; the card settles from your ZCHF balance.

cases.title: Protocol savings
cases.description: Deposit ZCHF in the protocol's savings module to earn the rate set by governance. Interest starts after an initial waiting period; you can withdraw at any time.

cases.title: Recurring savings plan
cases.description: Set up a recurring savings plan in ZCHF or BTC, for yourself or for someone else. Funds stay in your own wallet and the ZCHF part earns the protocol savings rate.

cases.title: Savings app with IBAN
cases.description: Fund a personal IBAN by bank transfer or deposit digital assets, allocate to a ZCHF, EUR or USD strategy, and withdraw when you need the money.

cases.title: Lend or borrow ZCHF
cases.description: Supply ZCHF to earn interest from borrowers, or borrow ZCHF against crypto collateral, in Morpho's lending markets on Ethereum and Base.

cases.title: Borrow crvUSD against svZCHF
cases.description: Deposit savings-vault tokens (svZCHF) as collateral and borrow crvUSD in Curve's isolated Ethereum market. Rates and liquidation terms are set by that market.

cases.title: Index fund component
cases.description: ZCHF is one of the components of the ixEDEL index fund on Reserve Protocol, alongside gold, Bitcoin and yield-bearing stablecoins.

cases.title: Tokenized shares
cases.description: Buy and sell tokenized shares of Swiss companies, and take part in their capital raises, with ZCHF as the settlement currency.

cases.title: Payroll
cases.description: Run payroll, social insurance and pension contributions for employees and settle the wages in ZCHF.

cases.title: Company treasury and rental deposits
cases.description: Treasury products for companies built on ZCHF, including rental deposits held in ZCHF.

cases.title: Custody
cases.description: Hold ZCHF in custody with Bitcoin Suisse, a Swiss crypto financial services provider, instead of in your own wallet.

cases.title: Institutional custody
cases.description: Institutions hold ZCHF in Copper's custody and can deploy it to DeFi from there, next to the rest of their digital assets.
